title: Plan and implementation mismatch
description: The plan requires a three-state optional value, while the implementation collapses it into bool.

plan.content:
# Publication options

The API must distinguish an omitted published value from explicit false and explicit true.

candidates.title: bool collapses omitted and explicit false

evidence.execution_path: JSON decoding leaves both an absent published field and published=false as the zero value false
evidence.violated_invariant: The implementation must preserve all three states required by the plan
evidence.falsifier_checked: The field has no pointer, presence bit, custom unmarshaler, or wrapper type

candidates.impact: Callers cannot request explicit false without being confused with omission, so update semantics diverge from the plan.
candidates.recommendation: Represent presence separately from the boolean value.

verdicts.reason: The snapshotted plan requires three states and the concrete representation has only two.
